name: 蘇程裕
objective:
本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解軌道車輛工程、機電工程及製造科技之最新研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
This course provides important information with respect to the latest developments or applications on railway engineering, energy engineering and automation technology. The invited speakers include well-known scholars in the engineering field and project executors from National Taipei University of Technology.
